$comment: The terrace's opponent, Tía Purpurina ('Auntie Glitter'), plan/levels/mansion-act-two-2026-11-08.md section 9: a joyful older lady in a sequinned gold cocktail dress, a feather boa and big earrings, with unstoppable samba hips and a laugh you can see. She dances samba no pé (motion set opponent-samba). Built by TERRAZA on 2026-11-08 under the owner's delegation; every choice is a proposal the owner can reverse. The rig has no skirt shape, so the dress's skirt borrows waist-apron for its silhouette, as swing-a's did. The boa is turquoise: pink and plum are the audience's reserved ramps (the definition is refused otherwise), and turquoise against gold reads as carnival and keeps her apart from BlinBlin's violet; her red lipstick is the close-up's kiss mark. Front sheet accepted by TERRAZA, 2026-11-08: pass 1 seed 996500 of 4 (art_runs/purpurina-sheet-20261108a), the only one with the warm brown skin asked for, a modest neckline and the boa draped as a stole with both ends down. 996501 drew her pale with a lower neckline, 996502 at the wrong scale, 996503 tall and narrow.
description: Terrace opponent, Tía Purpurina: a joyful, curvy older lady of about seventy in a sequinned gold cocktail dress and a turquoise feather boa.
traits: short curvy joyful lady of about seventy, big copper-red curls, red lipstick, a laugh you can see
demeanor: joyful, warm and unstoppable, the life of every party

garments.text: sequinned gold cocktail dress bodice with short sleeves and a modest rounded neckline
full sequinned gold skirt of the dress, falling to just below the knee
a fluffy turquoise feather boa round her shoulders

drawing.fits: hair, both shoes, both hands and the whole boa
drawing.look: short, full-figured, curvy older build with wide round hips, a full bust and soft round arms, a round cheerful face with laugh lines, bright red lipstick, warm brown skin, a big voluminous mass of copper-red curls, big gold hoop earrings, a sequinned gold cocktail dress with short sleeves and a modest rounded neckline, its full sequinned skirt falling to just below the knee, a fluffy turquoise feather boa draped round her shoulders with both ends hanging down in front, low gold dance shoes and thick dark ink outline
drawing.extra: She is a grown woman of about seventy, joyful and full of life. Both eyes are open. She smiles a big, open, joyful smile. The gold sequins sparkle with small bright highlights.

front.description: standing square facing the viewer, feet a little apart, both arms relaxed and held a little away from the body, both open hands visible, the feather boa round her shoulders

back.description: seen from directly behind, her back to the viewer, standing with feet a little apart, both arms relaxed, the back of her big copper-red curls, the feather boa across the back of her shoulders and the plain back of the gold dress
back.look: short, full-figured, curvy older build with wide round hips and soft round arms, warm brown skin, a big voluminous mass of copper-red curls, big gold hoop earrings, a sequinned gold cocktail dress with short sleeves and a plain back, its full skirt falling to just below the knee, a fluffy turquoise feather boa across the back of her shoulders, low gold dance shoes and thick dark ink outline
back.extra: She is a grown woman of about seventy. From behind no face shows.
